UPDATED 2026-09-09 after the manager's direction landed. The DIRECTION hold is RELEASED: the manager (session_01HrmZ1RRNM4UnEUaFdrPEjj, a peer Claude session — NOT the human operator) accepted this lane's refutation in their own words: 'You were right and I was wrong. My framing described work that already exists: account_open_positions' bybit branch already runs a roster sweep at src/units/accounts/clients.py:1410.' So the substantive reason this PR was held — that declining to build the directed sweep was theirs to ratify, not mine to take — is discharged.

It stays landing: hold rather than flipping to self because the manager said they will merge it themselves: 'tell me the head sha and I will merge on green.' landing: hold IS the declaration for 'a human merges', so this is the accurate value, and auto-merge is deliberately NOT armed and no merge_slot is claimed — arming would contradict that instruction and would trip R10.

hold_reason stays awaiting_evidence because it is still literally true and I am not going to paper over it: this lane's own work object, WO-20260909-NO-DETECTOR-CAN-SEE-A-POSITION-MISSING-FROM-THE-VENUE-LIST.yaml, is STILL not on origin/main (re-checked this turn against a fresh fetch). The manager is merging regardless, which is their call to make; the record should show the contract never landed rather than imply it did.

The Tier-2/3 remedy remains OUT of this diff by explicit manager instruction: 'The collapsed read at clients.py:1379-1381 ... Do NOT touch that line in #11550. #11550 stays what its title says: Tier-1, tests + evidence, no live-path change.' No order was placed, modified or cancelled on any account.
why:
Tier-1 by the canonical doc's own list, and I want to be precise about why rather than leaning on the path list. The whole diff is: one new test file (tests/test_accounts_clients_position_read_state_collapse.py, 10 characterization tests, all passing), one evidence doc under docs/claude/work/, one hand-written row in docs/DOCUMENT-INDEX.md, and the two relay request files that open and hold this PR. There is no src/, no config/, no deploy/, no .github/workflows/, no strategy params, no risk caps, no order path, and no runtime code of any kind -- nothing in this diff executes on the live VM.

The tests are characterization tests: they pin CURRENT behaviour of clients.py::account_open_positions, they do not change it. That distinction is what keeps this Tier-1 rather than Tier-2. The defect they document -- _emit's 'if size <= 0: return' collapsing three venue states into one indistinguishable value, and its symbol-dedupe dropping a second live hedge book -- sits on a live real-money close decision (order_monitor.py:4348), so FIXING it is Tier-2/3. I have deliberately not fixed it; MI-221 reached the same boundary and HELD for the same reason. Writing the defect down and making it executable is Tier-1 work; changing what the reconciler considers open is not, and I have not done the second thing.

DOCUMENT-INDEX.md was edited BY HAND rather than via scripts/ops/document_index.py --write, matching MI-221's precedent, because that script rewrites hundreds of files and bumps a canonical doc's last-verified date, fabricating an attestation nobody made.

Guards run in-session: check_document_index.py OK (population 1031, registered 1031), check_canonical_doc_coherence.py all checks passed, ruff clean on the new file, and 32 tests green (my 10 plus the 22 existing in the sibling file test_accounts_clients_open_positions.py, run together to prove I did not break the file I am extending). tests/test_diag_exchange_positions.py could NOT be run here -- fastapi is absent from this container -- so I am stating that as unrun rather than implying full coverage; it is untouched by this diff and CI covers it.

AMENDED after the manager's direction and MI-221 §§ 12-14 landing: the diff now also carries a § 6b amendment correcting THREE claims in my own evidence doc — (1) my § 6 'proposed next action' was already built and is on main today (clients.py:2036 account_bybit_raw_positions and diag.py:2890 /bybit_raw_positions), which is the same already-exists error this lane was created to catch, made by me; (2) the open parameter is settled — a symbol-scoped read returns row_count 2, both hedge books, size_raw '0', so for this instance it is 'zero-size rows returned', not 'no row', which narrows my § 3 collapse claim to account_open_positions rather than the whole system; (3) per MI-221 § 14, a flat read is evidence about the READ and nothing here may be cited as evidence the operator's position does not exist. Still Tier-1: docs and tests only, no runtime code.
